SELECT 'booking' AS kind, json_object('booking_id',b.booking_id,'request_id',b.request_id,'flight',b.flight_id,'passenger',b.passenger_id,'amount',b.amount_cents,'status',b.status,'client_reference',b.client_reference,'charges',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('id',c.charge_id,'key',c.idempotency_key,'amount',c.amount_cents,'state',c.state,'created',c.created_step)) FROM charges c WHERE c.booking_id=b.booking_id),'cancel_events',(SELECT json_group_array(json_object('kind',e.kind,'step',e.step)) FROM customer_events e WHERE e.request_id=b.request_id)) AS data FROM bookings b WHERE b.status<>'confirmed' UNION ALL SELECT 'outbox', json_object('event_id',event_id,'booking',booking_id,'payload',payload,'status',status,'attempts',attempts) FROM outbox WHERE status<>'delivered' UNION ALL SELECT 'flight',json_object('id',f.flight_id,'capacity',capacity,'price',price_cents,'version',version,'holds',(SELECT count(*) FROM holds h WHERE h.flight_id=f.flight_id)) FROM flights f UNION ALL SELECT 'cache',json_object('key',key,'value',value) FROM cache UNION ALL SELECT 'fare_hold',json_object('id',hold_id,'flight',flight_id,'price',price_cents,'until',until_step) FROM fare_holds UNION ALL SELECT 'config',json_object('service',service,'value',value) FROM service_config
